notes.title: Join the King’s Raid CBT on Steam!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596650/15c58ed4e671655d63faebb66503949710f8183b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]We are excited to announce the upcoming King’s Raid Closed Beta Test (CBT)![/b][/p][p][b] This test will run exclusively on Steam (PC) and is designed to verify system stability and game balance ahead of our official launch.[/b][/p][p][b]We invite all interested players to sign up for a chance to participate. Selected testers will receive an email with detailed instructions on how to access the CBT.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]■ Recruitment Details[/h3][list][*][p][b]Recruitment Period[/b]: Starting September 18, 2025 (KST) ~ Until further notice[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tester Announcement[/b]: To be announced (via email)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Test Period[/b]: To be announced[/p][/*][*][p][b]Test Platform[/b]: Steam (PC)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]■ How to Apply[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Click the Apply for CBT button on the [url="http://kr.masanggames.com/?lang=en"]official website[/url][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Enter your email, agree to the terms, and submit your application.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Once recruitment closes, selected players will receive an email with details on how to access the CBT.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Follow the instructions in the email to install the client and start playing.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][b]■ Test Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]The CBT will use a closed build for testing purposes. All data will be reset once the test ends.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Please report bugs, errors, and feedback through the dedicated Discord channel.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Feel free to record, share, and upload gameplay videos and other content.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cheating or breaking our policies may result in removal from the test.[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]■ Additional Information[/h3][list][*][p][b]CBT keys will only be issued to selected testers. Each key can be redeemed once per person.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Transferring or trading CBT keys may result in penalties.[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: King’s Raid Steam Wishlist Event
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596650/c9da2fd34431746e29b28e985a94cd1308530105.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello,[/p][p]As previously announced, we are preparing to bring [b]King’s Raid[/b] to Steam![/p][p]We would like to sincerely thank everyone who has been waiting to enjoy King’s Raid on Steam.
To show our gratitude, we are launching the [b]Steam Wishlist Event[/b]![/p][p]Add [b]King’s Raid[/b] to your Steam wishlist now, and after launch, rewards will be distributed based on the total number of wishlists achieved together by the community.[/p][p]Check out the details below![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]▶ Steam Wishlist Milestone Event Details[/b][/h3][h3][b]Event Period[/b][/h3][p]Until the official launch[/p][h3][b]Event Details[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Rewards will be given based on the number of wishlists achieved.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards will be [b]cumulative[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]How to Participate[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Go to the Steam store and search for [b]“King’s Raid”[/b]
→ \[Go to King’s Raid Steam Page][/p][/*][*][p]Log in to Steam and add [b]King’s Raid[/b] to your wishlist[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3][b]Milestone Rewards[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]30,000[/b] : Jane[/p][/*][*][p][b]50,000[/b] : New Costume for Frey[/p][/*][*][p][b]70,000[/b] : Jane Exclusive Weapon[/p][/*][*][p][b]100,000[/b] : Special Reward[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Reward Distribution[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reward distribution schedule will be announced after the official service launch.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Notes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Event details and duration may be subject to change or early termination without prior notice.[/p][/*][*][p]Reward distribution schedule and claiming methods will be announced separately at a later date.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We look forward to your continued interest and support for [b]King’s Raid[/b].
Thank you![/p]

notes.title: King’s Raid Partner Creators Recruitment Notice
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596650/836e53f3053590b336c00ad22951dd8586a42eb7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Do you stream or create video content for King’s Raid?[/p][p]Join the [b]King’s Raid Partner Creators[/b] Program today![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🔹 Eligibility[/b][/p][list][*][p]Active creators on a streaming platform or video channel[/p][/*][*][p]100+ subscribers/followers[/p][/*][*][p]Able to comply with the \[activity requirements] below[/p][/*][*][p]Open to all platforms (no restrictions)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]🔹 Activity Requirements (Including Eligibility Maintenance)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upload at least 3 King’s Raid-related videos per month[/p][list][*][p]Live streams and VODs both count[/p][/*][*][p]2 Shorts = 1 VOD/stream[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Activities will be continuously reviewed; failure to meet standards may result in removal from the program[/p][/*][*][p]Partner Creators must follow higher standards of conduct[/p][/*][*][p]Mandatory compliance:[/p][list][*][p]Masangsoft’s Terms of Service and King’s Raid operational policies[/p][/*][*][p]Use only your own account (account sharing/borrowing prohibited)[/p][/*][*][p]Maintain exemplary behavior in gameplay, streaming, and community activities[/p][/*][*][p]If personal circumstances arise, eligibility may be retained with prior notice[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]🔹 Partner Creators Benefits[/b][/p][list][*][p]In-game support (details to be announced)[/p][/*][*][p]Promotional and visibility support[/p][/*][*][p]Community and communication support[/p][/*][*][p]Additional rewards (details to be announced)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]📌 Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]This program is designed to provide a better creative environment for King’s Raid creators.[/p][/*][*][p]Selected applicants will be individually notified via email with further instructions.[/p][/*][/list][p]Join the King’s Raid Partner Creators program and help us build a richer, and more diverse content ecosystem together![/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/yJisqUqGHXb3HmQ17"]👉 \[Apply Here][/url][/p]

notes.title: TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025 – We’re Going!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596650/dc160f9799d51e39dc9ce4e4fc38bbc49678b358.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🎉 King’s Raid is heading to TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]To all fans who have been waiting for the return of King’s Raid, we’re excited to share some big news![/p][p][/p][p]From September 25–28, King’s Raid will be featured at Tokyo Game Show (TGS 2025) in Japan.[/p][p][/p][p]At our booth, you’ll be able to experience the PC (Steam) demo version of King’s Raid for the very first time in Japan, take part in fun interactive events, and even grab exclusive goodies.[/p][p][/p][p]This is your chance to enjoy the excitement and special moments that can only be experienced on-site at TGS! 🎮[/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to meet you there, so don’t forget to stop by the King’s Raid booth![/p][p]Your support and participation mean the world to us.[/p][p][b]
[/b][/p]

notes.title: August Developer's Note - Character Reveal
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596650/31714e6b21ccf50810e9c5deb34150ccfc4feb31.jpg"][/img]Hello, this is the King’s Raid Development Team at Masangsoft.[/p][p]
In this Developer’s Note, we’d like to give you a brief introduction to the heroes that will be available when the service officially opens.[/p][p]The most important factor we considered when selecting the launch characters was [b]role balance across attack attributes[/b].[/p][p]
We carefully adjusted the lineup so that no matter which attribute you choose, you won’t face major difficulties progressing through the game. We also reviewed the order in which heroes are introduced to make sure that no single attribute is placed at an overwhelming disadvantage when building your party.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, let us introduce the 31 heroes who will join you on this new journey:[/p][p][/p][p] [b]1. Knights[/b][/p][p]Frontline defenders who protect and support allies, with many defensive skills that reduce party-wide damage.[/p][p][b]​​​​​​​​​​​​​​\[Physical] Clause, Demia[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcrW8ooqY8QNzoQHr2vQosH8G7blnk4D2DuMd8m_7AvMcky7mAGS3n03HE0qnCI6kjCiPRsGWR5MykMEHPBzy7m-cNcepXzzHHBZf_TK7Uf2InkzIprYU-CuXoafSsRHPafcTfd?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXel79LelmwANogl2IwbC7wlRI5ZHeYlSG8vQJJkTtbZw6nfEoGkL6BdQuzDL8OXmepLrrSO2im0lOCVpgYDfzbEAh73j1Cn1vNEmYTSV_cDyolU8GjZOhyTsLVAxV7T-sQLXPf2?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Magic] Morrah, Jane, Sonia[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfXlboTmg3bqtwMoOCTg9xQZ9CMGkMVYLyEHWeQ_EiqlJsUj8qt_x-Rngjbk2K1oqeiB9r9XH2Bcjvw8Dy3qOS9h70_AiACge1SMYHTVQcNu9NyH4pteldE2YgmeXrLhEh8KgwxmA?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdIpfCczDYo5cRPAnJ150tTNP9Etl7vn1xQjtap8NgHkEfFVZSE_2RJ1IqA_sLcrDdger4OUzIdm3PtEsR7dO1U5p2w2sKDuWEu6ZRQLQCinr3YFhuL4BvJRr543ZcaQO1m2ZvXEA?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfaA7Ko1_qQ78TJVLczxg6GOkjpBlrr0dNiIetBWbfIXkcBM7QkLDvgMWdUNUFzmZ08-tEsUjUE08J8_dwOfb0j3WeNMg_p-8BzyP4ve9Bs6pdmHYrSQAcvA_1eJyNDz-z7tVEVkg?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]2. Warriors[/b][/p][p]Durable fighters who battle alongside Knights on the front line, sustaining long engagements.[/p][p]​​​​​​​Some provide support, while others strike powerful blows against nearby enemies.[/p][p][b]\[Physical] Kasel, Gau, Naila, Priscilla[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfQV9PRIvoMtCD1DOul3C2uqs6clxKko-vig2ex40VJaMP_lgtEzHah__wuPB1xZ-AV1SPx5d-8S-1bIjVwjLdo2DHAHX9clQBQDmyV1YWE-OomUbRemHqLD7aRDr_39y6dOs9o4w?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXexJOjIua5j1WjBNgSvZRai33vxZ9bnOSdZNrfRzntXl5oE7nsgAg2BiBD5zaCU9t64nsZkWc8j-YmOlrKt0TNXyHNS-cBeX8IL2wD_2hURI9L1kThI-2OKzRS4712fjBVGAWAGAA?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeTGXUbbVZlQiUIfjNPawCwtTnuOYMohAzpBP7pjX1TGy0vuGIrjgvkTyRKjBWipbn_cwdMo24ueVVVzjZvhNH4DP698YA-0NsCTqi5DnhY2P_oGNqFKN5o9blzLQ8dwUKiyv3R?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcve1Bl3dGXjVZTPCMcOuulc4U8THsl9Nkmw_r1PNCLOJlmoFYbgrA5XjNhQKgAvbxD3-eu_VLgx7Oe8lkIToMcyqcbchH63nwPO38hCPXIY_ZtJgtD69k1zkwTmgIiI3aKq53Zow?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Magic] Kirze[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXes8yXZ2q0dNphEXiaFkX1TngPr3VSeBL6dZK_-mE94PObmSovnri5UiqUW8ipFNhoDQet8nA-p1OqNGUM5XJ9KjwZLfECPDKWe6JFXj5VTOu-VOOTNt4eeKOfE2myYxC2UT1xpvw?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]3. Assassins[/b][/p][p]Experts at striking weaknesses or infiltrating the backline to eliminate key targets.[/p][p]Known for high single-target damage.​​​​[/p][p][b]\[Physical] ​​​​​​​Roi, Reina[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd0C9tKOQ6OzJBA4ItS89LYv2VFB09GmoqJK4-_rFWKTn_X1wBkQYvkGnSygSWHzErIDcmfspBb1o-_Z_j1dezogszHs_HSD8qIEe8eWmaB4PWY8QbqNZpMNQlftp_OKri3VUMYUw?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfnsnoFFCdWx00uY7dUkMZ0otibwwkxHx7LMELHLkSmc_6Aqiw7XP7wr7NCBOBEUBpYZ9zhq9LpP4a297uy6JOKlEDrSwz8tfnvxaHmR2gDYMrXNYcKAF697IuDRH9mhIqLZiwI?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Magic] ​​​​​​​Epis, Mirianne[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfLQby14B2XYrxyQo-mrOgD5GCePmogwspl2A58S9jFffxdt6UTlikq4wuYCtvMekA7DzvEAAZOzv609CV1talIDW_Bbd_3u3bc9pf-nNpos_FkdiLiBYRh6xi5IAJ2R9DZQKIBxw?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcp1zSD8zuyTCXtQlECMq4WS3X8geKVNrACOgdTZ9tFv2aMGLpMwZg67Jn6DV38z0_LsNO1ngxDuxyyJRCx9G7vBHb0QHPr2_rRRI2pIQL7LScN-SrDMp0mCi4PBBOQYtBaNT_6hg?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]4. Archers[/b][/p][p]Reliable ranged attackers who can deal heavy damage even to enemies with strong defenses or block rates.[/p][p]Some also provide support abilities.[/p][p][b]\[Physical] ​​​​​​​Selene[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf3-wXIJvt-_w0Yjhr_yvTj8zgj0UfLuTun8XfIWVYvaaZCbtX_Mh7zCv4mQrtuSKOUMRDCv9QZJbc2YhPYpgQ8ne8_Iw_ie79VswpypFsAX_vjJHaR1m31OCgHZHc-k97GJsnomg?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Magic] ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Dimael, Luna, Arch[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcpNbPH7rGUoYCdP6FicAeVcawtlLryGqI7yHKcWG6rYIxZ7Knbfjf3xb58atGvUH-kDxq6bD5HuwyMqT8ENzCH4395jrM8IZyW3PUfwvz7lH69GbRjki7PUHB2odmZ8HgH7Xasug?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdh_vzxjdqpTabNRYS98_X6vBW5NLFOuaooXI3R38KSswbXujwhzOCHyLOBwuh3zXdnq5h6xq8upiZSC_5ZJfsVzEDcpUUGAT4bkzMiYLMQ8mgAla5lcSHOljHmlTNZLv-CcpQ7Lg?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcLCRJll163H-K5y6q3uiEmGMkcwXh0OuaNAkxTQdcnW_s8RAX8dC60QF6g5KQd9VMB18Wfr56KQEM2ms5mk0qwsGSaa5A0T9udPUENl3a5Iqo20TGa9lm_E73VzVx4uswmKG5p9Q?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]5. Mechanics[/b][/p][p]Inventors who unleash wide-area attacks or provide support.[/p][p]Most excel at AoE, though some specialize in single-target damage.[/p][p][b]\[Physical] ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Lakrak, Miruru, Rodina[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcU7SWcIB9Uzrr8QNjpiUaQeyroNXfPt9Mt0qzirjlP6gywBK1hxHEgDDesoHhYfRfD5LGbE7nTeC1pahs-Zu6gW_ZvwWwulk08o-Hmzwpe7O9NNmkKcy1qIRywLy9C6m01p24xQw?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdJ-tjwbbNd3dE-RN1ioyCSAxBhUubkVzbS4WiUD0R4BrRtagUt780CEzyRqFhB16jVMD69B07v112shbhJbUBsV-ZBlhNL-H8clqJFaBanBz4hECfCpDIE2yFtFKrW8UeQp4MNYw?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf24Ui2P85pVarU8oiiAOpKcah-I1Y9cfc25wBoR7If3nxFbYbfs9sy3dnZU_V7GpXt9v7LWPmdZGmQbQzud1BAw7sXTRlUrtFqcWrnxUK6Y_0P9uQbo-ll2BzsYJoPZbDeczBVjQ?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Magic] ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Annette[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdI6sWYdvtC51-CFaXqVa7VO14NbZAGN7TY09_hZBRmyCcdEb33eBikc2u3k9Rgm_m7IeIqujc3rf9vh_aVYtVWx_zVGdRZfWX4ZK7yIXoSXtGg29RrcZ3fwba83aviEakR8JYo?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]6. Wizards[/b][/p][p]Wielders of powerful area magic and mana control.[/p][p]Primarily damage-focused, with some heroes offering supportive abilities.[/p][p]​​​​​​​[b]\[Magic] ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Cleo, Maria, Lorraine[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeIcpm_1lRkI7tO1oyKyObdkLY1INReszfaVv7XQnPOtCGRBYM5oOgVsl8gdE3ngabnuv9HRD-GQMUxLm2soGliCqXQdysDkH5TL1z76SGTUAGYNEUo1OZdrO6dQ4iEBdAXiOtuzg?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcH6jZNhUuWbH6wGOCjuFPd2aoOAaHVng1OevNtxc6QX0rSb9MFJmhrkiQr1fT3K36NR_4wnXm62B3_QdLdnBMAvPpokp0ZqXaWv86CWcB35b-GsjbiN5-eI3E8nBCc6PGX7Wr9rw?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdybpSROASOSM1PVrPli4kN1qEFwTjzGxqWl7aB1eKqShKo7HXByFENCsL4HF5Y981BrbVQP5XR8M78VCisYKga7iFCRUrXsGhz47HpAprgJjQhqOTwtB6UT-9IPWossZDNiBLxBA?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]7. Priests[/b][/p][p]Dedicated healers and supporters.[/p][p]All provide recovery, while some also enhance allies of specific attributes.​[/p][p][b]\[Physical] ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Leo[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf9uB2mp2hLP30ijwUGzKrNYXolQzX4oEOzqM4wiiPZaA9BhB4zx-F6b5R-E_MeVwMhw720qXqVLlh3g0_3YtF-QpZpRd0-lTAZn2oH0thzYUlnBEa0sD234Z_FHDiJmSQAyDiP5A?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Magic] ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Frey, Kaulah, Rephy, Baudouin, Laias[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcBGE3qv67UxSed5WmBienYeQew0W41vdM60KA5KqZB9ctOPT2s_5UfYcdU-ecdbPcovQacZadvRmsYcJSod-WoHNeXNWO-w2nERPGgwEBmtyA8AZNsUfw74gGJVIPqFBljEzEsug?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeiRxuhzsISNGZsWlYapvs0Npb7MI3L4SicXB32sd0kXWTj7gQqp5l1XuAizIkkypS-XrbkhaaP0WSzlETrHpp13siacjuO5nH30qE20AU_Jrh93s5fjEu-rscEDVH8lgw1NzCuAw?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcgJBQrs2_-f-gIU4H07WPYvPQG_9WFCGUKqmfJu5Ipyvjj7Z6uEGfU-5DefRkf7MxtbfRlwpv0Wl2uviNwL6Z27lI_vqkbyzQ9RnVsRmCEjLVAIeEEg9p9BYX46ozt1HqBurlGwg?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfv07Ps3iZfmcLuRJDaiJLgdJRgvWF-WycQSToIPsBeMIHm_OJfOT0gk8RHIKHEZwTcm6TYWDG9s6O4Vfj6puH4Gc7sBqAHNRJBtt9uAVvkW7E2LoFW-Pp6OS1MR23Uhro01NqA?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfo7qCKLOjwDqD_QWgx4X2RkFw-B5HeV2SdWA6UKocugm3-MolPb2x_CDoNorxffLVf6ZKc4KIxyz5p2RMhQ9E5eM_Nj71U68cRSdfwl2FXkoFyLl2cvdARak93IqQswFiYh6z-ZQ?key=9zJ5W7Xl8H1z9DigsJtDGA"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That concludes today’s introduction.[/p][p][/p][p]Even after launch, we will continue to monitor balance closely and prioritize adding heroes with the roles needed to ensure smooth party composition across all attributes.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely thank you for your unwavering support of King’s Raid. Every opinion you share on Discord is carefully reviewed by the development team, and we will continue doing our best to make King’s Raid a game built together with our players.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: King’s Raid Official Discord Server Now Live
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596650/21000f1d95bfaac3cf31ef1b0d9bffa076405b8e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p][b]The official King’s Raid Discord server is now open![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Join our community to get the latest updates on development news, events, and more. You’ll hear it here first, straight from the source.[/b][/p][p][b]It’s also a space to connect and chat with fellow players from around the world who are looking forward to the return of King’s Raid.[/b][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Tap the link below to join and be part of the conversation:[/b][/p][h2][url="https://discord.gg/TyvYcF4gjn" style="button" buttoncolor="#5865f2"]▶ \[Join the Official King’s Raid Discord] ◀[/url][/h2][h1][/h1][p][b]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts. See you on Discord![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]※Please check the server rules and guidelines before participating.[/b][/p][p][b]※The official Discord supports Korean, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, and Global (English).[/b][/p][p][b]※When you join, you’ll be able to access language-specific channels based on your selected role.[/b][/p]
